files.html:
# 0.1.1 Change Log

## Added

- Added the Nurse Joy Editor and Nurse Joy NPC role. A CustomNPC can now use a nearby Cobblemon healing machine to run dialogue, movement, treatment animations, and party healing.
- Added Pokemon gender selection with Random, Male, Female, and Genderless options.
- Added CobbleDollars as a trainer victory reward.

## Changed

- Existing trainer JSON files are upgraded automatically, with older Pokemon entries defaulting to Random gender.
- Trainer previews, battles, and PokeMart Pokemon now use the same form, Aspect, and gender handling.

## Fixed

- Fixed species-specific forms missing from the form selector.
- Fixed Hisuian and other alternate forms falling back to the base Pokemon when no Aspect was selected manually.
- Fixed disabled Trainer and Pokemon-self roles still opening battle interactions.
- Fixed NPC Apply status and removal for Trainer and Pokemon-self bindings.
